judged_text: Removing the last member of the final page strands the UI on an empty page: after a successful removal, findMembers() re-fetches with the unchanged offset, so if the removed member was the only one on the last page the refetch returns an empty list and the admin is left on an empty page until manually clicking previous; offset should be re-clamped against the new total after deletion

record.issue_text: Removing the last member of the final page strands the UI on an empty page: after a successful removal, findMembers() re-fetches with the unchanged offset, so if the removed member was the only one on the last page the refetch returns an empty list and the admin is left on an empty page until manually clicking previous; offset should be re-clamped against the new total after deletion

adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group#removeMember`, after a successful DELETE it calls `self.findMembers()` without changing `offset` (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`). `findMembers()` clamps the request offset using the *current* `this.get("user_count")` (pre-deletion) and the current `this.get("offset")`, then sends that offset to `/groups/:name/members.json` (`offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0))`). The server endpoint `GroupsController#members` does not re-clamp `offset` against the new total (it just uses `offset = params[:offset].to_i`), so if you delete the only member on the last page (e.g., total goes from 51 to 50 with limit 50, offset remains 50), the refetch returns an empty `members` array and the UI stays on an empty page until the user clicks previous.
